question: Should the task-suggestion follow-up be fixed now by adding an action-sink capability and Gateway-backed TUI accept/dismiss UX, or should tools remain Control UI-only until that UX is sponsored?
rationale: The issue has a protected maintainer label and the best fix crosses agent tool construction, Gateway event policy, and TUI operator UX, so deterministic cleanup should not choose the product boundary alone.

options.title: Sponsor the focused action-sink fix
options.body: Add the explicit action-sink capability, update tool construction and Gateway/TUI handling, and prove both tool exposure and TUI accept/dismiss behavior.

options.title: Keep suggestions Control UI-only for now
options.body: Gate task-suggestion tools to the existing Control UI action sink and leave Gateway-backed TUI support for a later UX issue.

options.title: Pause for broader task UX design
options.body: Keep this issue open as maintainer-owned design work if the action model should cover more surfaces before implementation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the focused action-sink fix
recommendation.body: Add the explicit action-sink capability, update tool construction and Gateway/TUI handling, and prove both tool exposure and TUI accept/dismiss behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the feature PR and the current bug report, and are assigned on the live issue.
